in_marathi.name: Hridayesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Owner of the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hridayesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hridayesh is derived from Sanskrit roots 'hrit' meaning heart and 'ayesh' meaning owner. This name signifies the one who owns or rules the heart. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the soul resides in the heart, and hence, the name Hridayesh symbolizes the one who holds the soul within.
